dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Sure! But, um... Could you help me find my precision machinery hex nut first?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where did you last see it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then, when did you last use it?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hm, when was it? Earlier today? Or maybe yesterday...? Sorry, when I get busy, I tend to lose track of time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, what do you usually do when you lose something?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oh, that's easy. Whenever my room gets too messy and I can't find something, I just call out, "INEFFA!"

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: It's the fastest way to fix the situation! Even if it means walking right into a lecture...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Huh, but you don't have somebody like that to help you. How do you survive?

choices.text: It's just a matter of staying organized...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: But, if I had to spend time on cleaning after pouring countless hours into making stuff, there'd be no time left over for snacks!

choices.text: Okay, so snacks are your main concern...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: What!? No, no, no! We need to be a united front! Like... a snack alliance!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Ah, I get it. You've forgotten how good a delicious, crumbly cookie can be, haven't you? Well, you're in luck, 'cause I've got extra! Here, we can—

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Hey! My hex nut! It was in my sleeve the whole time!

choices.text: I think I understand Ineffa a whole lot better now...
After a while, it becomes a habit...
